items.html:
Implemented root physics dispatch and completed shared framework coverage:

  • Constructors, sphere/cylinder classmethods, waves, clusters, periodic responses, S-matrices, and constant-receiver methods select adapters automatically.
  • Added T-matrix rotation, translation, averages, metrics, and legacy interaction methods.
  • Added periodic scattering, cylindrical conversion, diffraction-order construction, and lattice-interaction methods.
  • Reused existing native derivative records; fixed unintended re-expansion of raw multicentre incident coefficients.

Verified 149 focused tests passed across Advect, JAX/JIT, PyTorch, and Autograd. Earlier 175 existing NumPy tests passed. Ruff and Pyrefly pass for owned implementation files.

Code is stable. Dynamic factor helpers reuse prepared coupling but record factorization per call; constant native factors retain LU reuse. No commits or pushes.
